prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Snorlax (잠만보) personified, normal type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut and skin tone; her figure follows BODY TYPE; expression and hair motion may change.

FACE: exactly the face of the attached image — the same face shape, jawline, eye shape and size, nose, lips and their proportions, and the same skin rendering. From any camera angle or pose — low or high camera, chin resting on a hand, profile, looking back — keep the reference image’s face shape, jaw length and face length-to-width ratio; perspective and pose must never lengthen her lower face or make her jaw look heavier than in the reference. Do not add skin texture, pores, harder nose or lip modelling, a face lengthened by the camera angle, a heavy jaw, or any facial definition the attached image does not have.

BODY TYPE: an hourglass figure with a subtly full bust, a slim waist and very wide, curvy rounded hips that flow smoothly into softly full thighs, the line tapering gradually toward the knees with no sudden narrowing below the hips, and slender lower legs — never thick or heavy — it reads clearly through the outfit. The attached image's armor hides her figure, so take her body shape from this line, not from the armor's outline; her head stays in natural adult proportion to her body.

STYLE: High-detail Japanese anime-style 2.5D character illustration. A refined adult anime face drawn to her own FACE line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Highly detailed clothing and accessories with convincing fabric weave, stitching, folds, seams, buckles and material-specific reflections. Combine stylized anime facial features with richly rendered dimensional clothing. Use luminous midtones and restrained highlights on clothing, keeping her own colours in soft, clean tints. Her skin has a glossy sheen — smooth, bright specular highlights on her shoulders, collarbones, chest, arms and thighs, a polished lustrous finish over her skin tone, never wet or oily. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her species shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never armor, never a creature costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

SETTING: a stylised stage, editorial or fantasy set, not bound to a real year — still one real adult woman in a believable space, no creatures.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: overgrown jungle temple ruins — mossy stone steps, hanging vines and shafts of light through the canopy
Time of day: dusk — blue hour, lights coming on.
Outfit: a bikini joined at the centre and hips by polished metal rings
Outfit colours: coral and soft orange — her own colour choice for this outfit, not her species' colours.
Cut: deep V neckline and high-cut leg built into the outfit — a figure-hugging fit that follows her curves; chest and pelvis stay securely covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head turned to the side; camera slightly below, looking up at her; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
LEGS: paused mid-walk, weight on the front foot.
GAZE: she looks toward the right of the frame.
EXPRESSION: raised inner brows, wide unsettled eyes, mouth slightly open, faint blush across the cheeks and nose. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: mostly active — an active mid-action moment compatible with the selected pose
source_influence: balanced — her species shows as one accessory and one object in the scene; the outfit keeps its own colours and patterns
separates_preference: balanced — choose either a one-piece outfit or separates to suit the scene

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face and hair — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her source belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions — about 7.5 heads tall, her head in proportion to her shoulders and body. No extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may leave the frame past the forearm, never floating without its arm; fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
